selection.note: Read all original requirement/ownership/context/capability and issue arrays. Direct dependency closure is supplemented by source-specific adjacent state/identity/offset clauses and split checks; the 342-record index records selection, not conformance.

runtime_profile.NormativeClosure: Explicit bounded MusicXML 4.0 source or current-model XSD, local clauses and shared exact musical timeline/effective-state assessment. The timeline provider finalizes typed part/measure/event and state evidence; its pass does not assert that every optional or ambiguous musical fact is known. The selected mandatory consumers are principal-note chord duration bounds and explicit numeral-key or applicable encoded effective-key presence at the harmony's unshifted score origin. Ordinary exact rational positions are not rounded. Ambiguous, missing, invalid or unsupported dependent evidence remains incomplete. Existing target-specific XSD, current-model representation, source syntax and unread external-DTD limits remain active. Broader repeat/span/intent/layout/playback consumers, packages, linked scores, external dictionaries and remaining normative closure are excluded. Opus selection assesses only that document, never linked scores. Counts are selected predicate instances, not complete MusicXML coverage.

acceptance: Never automatically load schemas, DTDs, external entities or XInclude.
Specify allowed but unsupported XML features as capability/security boundaries.

positive: Legal prolog DOCTYPE does not cause network/filesystem fetch; schema hints are value-checked only.
negative: A malicious external-entity or XInclude URL never reaches an automatic fetcher.

Nullable/nested/large occurrence grammar retains current polynomial evidence.
Invalid owner/skipped descendant suppresses only unavailable absence claims, not known duplicate or independent required attr failure.

source_contracts.title: Exact source scalar and cache identity
source_contracts.batch4_obligation: Reuse root exact scalar/facet/canonical semantics once per stable source/domain/union-member/whitespace view; expose canonical atomic values only with proven type evidence.
required_tests: Huge valid staves, fraction duration, exponent forbidden for decimal, inherited facets, selected-member order and lexical-pattern versus canonical difference.
Malformed lexical versus resource/capability failures remain distinct; repeated checks do not repeat unbounded parse work.

Pinned yyyy-mm-dd uses full XSD1.0 calendar validity: valid leap day, invalid February30, no year zero, signed/arbitrary-width budgeted years and absent versus UTC timezone; no regex/time.Time-only substitute.

source_contracts.title: Actual type and nil
source_contracts.batch4_obligation: Reuse QName scope, derivation/block/final/abstract, cvc-elt fallback, actual attrs/content, declaration nillability/default/fixed. Resolve source facts before model filtering.
required_tests: Equivalent namespace prefixes and whitespace; missing/cyclic type metadata incomplete not false xsi:type failure.
True nil still validates actual attrs; nil content/non-nillable errors remain normative.

source_contracts.title: Datatype-only schema hints
source_contracts.batch4_obligation: User choice is fixed: schemaLocation list(anyURI), noNamespace anyURI; no pair-cardinality rejection and no fetch/schema selection.
required_tests: Zero, one, odd/even valid URI tokens accepted by datatype layer; XML whitespace splitting and anyURI lexical cases.
Fetcher counter stays zero; changed hint cannot change selected assembly.
source_contracts.later_boundary: Batch8 discovery pairing retained separately; do not ask user to decide this again.

source_contracts.title: Physical presence and effective defaults
source_contracts.batch4_obligation: Do not rewrite source/model to implement defaults; preserve source occurrence identity and distinguish absent physical attribute, effective default, nil, empty text and canonical constraint value.
required_tests: Explicit zero versus absent; empty element default/fixed with lexical pattern; xsi actual type accepts/rejects canonical constraint separately.
source_contracts.later_boundary: Absent optional default/fixed ID participation and arbitrary constructed identity stay batch9.

source_contracts.title: XSD identity entries and containing owners
source_contracts.batch4_obligation: Do not substitute generic string-key ID plans for XSD1.0 declaration-eligible entry/actual-ID binding distinction; owners are source nodes, not paths or musical scope.
required_tests: Same-owner equal ID children, distinct owners, unseeded dynamic ID, root scalar ID without owner; original59-fixture expectations.
Declaration and actual-type failure gates separate; forward/missing resolution finalizes only with complete scope.

source_contracts.title: Metadata discovery and replay provenance
source_contracts.batch4_obligation: Preserve PR31 new-cause discovery versus cached replay epochs and genuine-invalid plus incomplete composition; no duplicate causes or false comparisons.
required_tests: State3 cached metadata replay updates incomplete event without rediscovering same cause.
State1 cycle discovered after unrelated error retains new cause; cold sink remains incomplete.

source_contracts.title: Schema capability boundaries
source_contracts.batch4_obligation: Retain opaque anyType/wildcard identity limitations, processContents skip versus unsupported lax/strict, general schema/UPA and unknown equality facts explicitly.
required_tests: Reached opaque/ENTITY path remains incomplete and does not erase independent normative invalidity.
Proven not-applicable versus unavailable capability distinguished per instance.
source_contracts.later_boundary: Batch9 broader primitive/default/list/union/DTD and general normative closure unless explicitly reviewed earlier.

source_contracts.title: Recoverable mid-element mapping failure
source_contracts.batch4_obligation: Source observer owns its own stack independently of generated decoder position. Disable mapper, discard candidate and drain same healthy parser from exact position.
required_tests: staves overflow followed by instruments then later missing ID/invalid source content/valid EOF.
Overflow in attribute, simple content and nested field leaves observer balanced.
No parser replay or second model candidate.

source_contracts.title: Fatal drain stop and joined causes
source_contracts.batch4_obligation: Recoverable mapping failure differs from fatal XML/I/O/session/budget/cancel failure. Stop feeding terminal session, Finish exactly once, join distinct mapping/source causes.
required_tests: Overflow then malformed tail; overflow then reader error; overflow then cancellation/resource cutoff.
errors.Is/As finds all actual causes; source violated/incomplete survives known earlier failure.

source_contracts.title: EOF and completion truth
source_contracts.batch4_obligation: Root closure alone is insufficient. SyntaxWellFormed/InputComplete require valid tail and actual EOF; missing nodes/IDs only after complete enumeration.
required_tests: Reader returns n>0 with EOF versus n>0 custom error; empty input; trailing comments/PIs; deliberate no-EOF interruption.
Known duplicate survives incomplete tail, unseen missing target does not become fail.

source_contracts.title: No rejected document escapes
source_contracts.batch4_obligation: Strict Decode returns Document only if nil operation error, Report.Satisfied and converted. Inspect violations live in report with nil op error; strict violated/incomplete returns error.
required_tests: Source violated+converted, source incomplete+converted, conformant+unrepresentable, conformant+converted, syntax failure+conversion failure.
Permissive Source.Requested=false is never Satisfied but does not block successful permissive decode.

source_contracts.title: New source error policy
source_contracts.batch4_obligation: Record exact typed source/strict/representability/configuration errors and legacy aliases. Pure conversion or unknown-only strict outcome must not match ErrInvalidDocument.
required_tests: Pure normative, pure incomplete, pure representability and joined errors.Is/As matrix; exact root UnsupportedRootError behavior.
ContextCanceled/Deadline/Resource retained; no fabricated ValidationIssue for technical facts.

source_contracts.title: Finite account constructed before parsing
source_contracts.batch4_obligation: Use one account for byte reader/parser/adapter/core/private binding; no hidden fresh account, resets/widening or duplicate core charges.
required_tests: Small quota exhausted across independent source private + core owners; sibling/live cleanup not refunded.
Zero finite defaults, negative before read, int64 overflow and actual 386 behavior.

source_contracts.title: Raw bytes and EOF probe
source_contracts.batch4_obligation: Bound original raw bytes before buffering; define one-byte limit probe/read-ahead accounting honestly; Reader may return data plus error.
required_tests: Exact-limit valid EOF passes; one extra byte fails as resource not syntax.
BOM/prolog/comments/tail count; one-byte reader and large-chunk reader same bounds/outcome.

source_contracts.title: Token growth before allocation
source_contracts.batch4_obligation: Post-Token accounting alone cannot bound encoding/xml token allocation. Provide bounded lexical/token growth or honest aggregate input bound with explicit limits before token allocations.
required_tests: Single huge text/attribute/comment/PI/DOCTYPE/name token; first-exceeding boundary and many small chunks.
Huge skipped foreign token consumes budget; cancellation cannot be deferred until unlimited token assembly.

source_contracts.title: Raw work versus emitted events
source_contracts.batch4_obligation: Declare raw token and namespace declaration/attribute attempts as distinct work from admitted core events; charge even discarded tokens and avoid same-resource duplicate wrapper charges.
required_tests: Comments/PIs-only flood; many namespace attrs; foreign subtree flood; rejected duplicate attrs.
Exact counter deltas for Open/Attribute/Close compared with raw token count.

source_contracts.title: Depth and private live retention
source_contracts.batch4_obligation: Tighter resolved Decode/assessment depth wins; charge private scalar/binding/namespace/candidate/fact retained payload and release owned live gauges once.
required_tests: Defaults versus low/high explicit depth in source-only/strict/permissive; hidden subtree at and above limit.
Failure at every growth site leaves gauges consistent; no sibling refund or cumulative-work refund.

source_contracts.title: Root XSD real work/cancellation
source_contracts.batch4_obligation: Existing root helper work is not charged by mere core reuse. Instrument actual grammar/scalar/index/metadata paths with checked work and cancellation without abandoning polynomial evidence.
required_tests: Near-limit grammar, large nullable cardinality, long whitespace/digit inputs, repeated references and metadata chains.
Cancel within work loops preserves preceding failures and reports incomplete.

source_contracts.title: Diagnostics are bounded outcomes
source_contracts.batch4_obligation: Route new source/binder/conversion diagnostics through bounded accumulation; success/NA never consume diagnostic quotas; preserve exact counts/blockers and reserved terminal summary.
required_tests: 1200-child/2-rule quota regression; fail after many successful source facts.
Huge hostile source value is escaped/bounded; zero retained room still exposes terminal cause.

source_contracts.title: Reader cancellation limitations
source_contracts.batch4_obligation: Check between reads/tokens/work and before large operations; do not promise to preempt arbitrary blocked Reader. Cleanup works with canceled ctx.
required_tests: Pre-canceled context no read, cancel between bytes/tokens/drain steps.
Reader-owned cancellation sentinel remains discoverable; Finish called once.

source_contracts.title: Preserve package boundaries
source_contracts.batch4_obligation: Root owns XML/model mapping; core stays stdlib-only and free of root, XML parser and network imports. Reuse/refactor rather than duplicate normative validator.
required_tests: Import-boundary tests and external-package source API usage.
A future direct-model fact adapter can consume the same selected plans without serialization.

source_contracts.title: Legacy permissive compatibility
source_contracts.batch4_obligation: Keep old functions and DecodeOptions layout, permissive filtering/model behavior and mandatory XML/security checks. Do not redirect legacy Validate or add prose rejection by default.
required_tests: Unkeyed DecodeOptions compile fixture; all typed decode/MXL paths retain behavior.
Well-formed unknown attributes/elements remain tolerated when unassessed; malformed hidden XML never tolerated.

source_contracts.title: Unsupported roots and version scope
source_contracts.batch4_obligation: Supported first source roots are existing musicxml/opus scope unless explicitly reviewed otherwise; known container/sounds labels are not implementation. Explicit4.0 profile does not mean version attribute must equal4.0.

Absent/other version values follow pinned domain/default, no invented4.0 enumeration.
source_contracts.later_boundary: Batch8 container/sounds generator/adapters; batch5 production profile scope.

source_contracts.title: Original-byte differential evidence
source_contracts.batch4_obligation: Run original XML against qualified independent oracles with --nonet; preserve per-case normative expectations and named divergences rather than majority behavior.

Verify required external selector actually executes each root, no skip; retain root-ID and identity oracle exclusions.

source_contracts.title: Catalog and source provenance preservation
source_contracts.batch4_obligation: Preserve all six schema bytes, generated public model, pinned registry and planning statuses unless a separately reviewed generation change is necessary; retain LF raw-hash checks.

New binding metadata retains all parameter/condition/source/use-site fields, no inventory shrink.

source_contracts.title: Profile denominator and traceability
source_contracts.batch4_obligation: Every enabled clause requires actual source positive/negative/boundary/missing/interaction evidence; generic/planned text is not an executed fixture. Count research rows separately from predicate decisions.

checks_original.semantics: Shared clause: octave-change contributes separately in addition to chromatic and any diatonic displacement; it is not already included in those fields. Chromatic plus twelve times octave-change derives sounding semitone displacement; diatonic plus seven times octave-change describes spelling displacement where diatonic is known. Additional clause supported by transpose-additive only: absent number applies the transpose to all staves of its containing part, while explicit number limits it to that staff. Absence defaults for any numeric child are delegated to their own schema or context contracts rather than invented here. Source evaluation uses observed structure, normalized values, and explicit presence. Model evaluation uses current model fields and presence only, without serialization, reparsing, or invented source spelling. Unknown or unsupported prerequisites produce incomplete results, never absence or success; invalid prerequisites block with a causal DecisionRef. Context defaults apply only to known absence. Resource limits are incomplete, not MusicXML defects. These are review-gated planning contracts and unexecuted future test cases.
checks_original.closure: Treat the two records as equivalent only for the separate-octave contribution; preserve staff scope provenance solely on transpose-additive and keep numeric absence behavior separately sourced. English/source clause review and observer capability review are required before promotion.
checks_original.implementation_binding: deferred_to_implementation; no provider, runtime selector compiler or Go field walker is implemented by this plan

research_clauses.MX40-PROSE-transpose-additive: Add transpose displacement to written pitch to obtain sounding pitch, with octave-change added separately to diatonic and chromatic contributions. Known absent number applies the transpose to all staves of the containing part; explicit number selects its staff.
research_clauses.MX40-PROSE-diatonic-plus-octave: octave-change contributes separately from diatonic and chromatic; both contributions are added to written pitch. This record does not supply the all-staves scope clause, which belongs to transpose-additive.

positive: Known written C4, chromatic=2, diatonic=1, octave-change=1 gives a fourteen-semitone sounding displacement and eight diatonic steps.
negative: The same values must not yield only two semitones by treating octave-change as already included, nor twenty-six by applying the octave twice.
boundary: Absent number covers all known staves in the containing part, not all score parts; explicit number 2 restricts the state to staff 2.
missing_fact: The octave-change value is unsupported by the model observer: sounding displacement is incomplete rather than assumed zero from this clause.
interaction: A staff-2 transpose does not affect staff 1, and the display-only octave-shift context must not add another sounding transposition.

candidate_ownership_original.semantics_contract: Require encoded musical content in every affected measure rather than treating the graphical repeat symbol as a substitute for notes/rests. Use duration-normalized, voice/staff-aware musical events; do not compare raw XML strings or merely count child nodes. Exact required event-equivalence, tied events and range construction remain gated. Do not execute playback repeat navigation as an assumed solution. Known complete absence may prove a false antecedent/not-applicable; unknown or unsupported facts never do. An invalid prerequisite blocks dependent evaluation with its causal DecisionRef. Resource exhaustion is incomplete, not a normative violation. Source facts use XML-normalized lexemes before the declared XSD whitespace policy. Model facts are current field values and structural presence only; no Encode/reparse and no invented original source spelling or position.

A stop belongs to the first span no longer displayed as a repeat; open span ending with the part must be supported.
missing_fact: Unresolved repeat start, incomplete part, unsupported backup/forward, invalid divisions or unknown pattern length makes affected-range/content comparison incomplete.
interaction: Grace, ties, multi-voice events and rests need dedicated equivalence cases; symbol presence alone never proves real music exists.

context_disposition_original.rationale: A normal note type different from the current note is represented by normal-type and normal-dot.
context_disposition_original.produces: An omitted normal-type can use the current note type only when the normal type does not differ.
context_disposition_original.closure: Separate normal-type difference detection, required representation, and normal-dot interpretation; define what evidence establishes an otherwise unstated intended difference. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

inputs: independent reviewed evidence of intended normal type if available
checks_original.selector: Notes with time-modification whose normal note type is compared with the current note type.
checks_original.applicability: A representation requirement can be evaluated only when the intended normal type and current note type are known; a numeric ratio alone is not proof of an unstated type difference.
checks_original.semantics: Candidate predicate: when the normal note type differs from the current note type, encode that difference with normal-type and its normal-dot content. When it is the same, normal-type may be omitted. Normal dots belong to the normal side of the relation, not automatically to the current note. Missing explicit normal-type does not itself prove a difference or failure; undecidable intended type remains unknown. Source evaluation uses observed structure, normalized values, and explicit presence. Model evaluation uses current model fields and presence only, without serialization, reparsing, or invented source spelling. Unknown or unsupported prerequisites produce incomplete results, never absence or success; invalid prerequisites block with a causal DecisionRef. Context defaults apply only to known absence. Resource limits are incomplete, not MusicXML defects. These are review-gated planning contracts and unexecuted future test cases.
checks_original.closure: Specify source-grounded evidence for an intended unstated normal type, exact dot fallback, and whether any residual requirement is observable beyond XSD. English/source clause review and observer capability review are required before promotion.

research_clauses.MX40-PROSE-transpose-additive: Add transpose displacement to written pitch to obtain sounding pitch, with octave-change added separately to diatonic and chromatic contributions. research_clauses.MX40-PROSE-diatonic-plus-octave: octave-change contributes separately from diatonic and chromatic; both contributions are added to written pitch. This record does not supply the all-staves scope clause, which belongs to transpose-additive.

positive: Known written C4, chromatic=2, diatonic=1, octave-change=1 gives a fourteen-semitone sounding displacement and eight diatonic steps.
negative: The same values must not yield only two semitones by treating octave-change as already included, nor twenty-six by applying the octave twice.
boundary: Absent number covers all known staves in the containing part, not all score parts; explicit number 2 restricts the state to staff 2.
missing_fact: The octave-change value is unsupported by the model observer: sounding displacement is incomplete rather than assumed zero from this clause.
interaction: A staff-2 transpose does not affect staff 1, and the display-only octave-shift context must not add another sounding transposition.

split_shared_checks.implemented_contribution: Separate actual and created-part transpose scopes; exact chromatic+12*octave and diatonic+7*octave projections.
split_shared_checks.evidence_scope: Only chronology/state or exact unit inputs are evidenced here; this does not execute the full original split consumer/default contract.
split_shared_checks.remaining_subclause: Shared clause: octave-change contributes separately in addition to chromatic and any diatonic displacement; it is not already included in those fields. Chromatic plus twelve times octave-change derives sounding semitone displacement; diatonic plus seven times octave-change describes spelling displacement where diatonic is known. Additional clause supported by transpose-additive only: absent number applies the transpose to all staves of its containing part, while explicit number limits it to that staff. Absence defaults for any numeric child are delegated to their own schema or context contracts rather than invented here. Source evaluation uses observed structure, normalized values, and explicit presence. Model evaluation uses current model fields and presence only, without serialization, reparsing, or invented source spelling. Unknown or unsupported prerequisites produce incomplete results, never absence or success; invalid prerequisites block with a causal DecisionRef. Context defaults apply only to known absence. Resource limits are incomplete, not MusicXML defects. These are review-gated planning contracts and unexecuted future test cases.

timeline.title: Exact cursor, duration, chord and event identities
timeline.batch6: Build bounded immutable exact rational positions and durations, event/measure/part identities, preserved document order, scope-local chronology, principal-note and chord evidence. No meter-fill predicate.
timeline.later: Batch 7 repeat navigation, span pairing, detailed performance transformations and intent; batch 9 final normative reconciliation.

positive: Divisions 3 with three duration-1 notes produces exact positions 0, 1/3, 2/3 and final cursor 1; divisions 1.5 and duration 0.5 gives 1/3.
Base duration 4 with chord tones 1 then 3 passes against the same base; next ordinary note begins at 4.
negative: Tone duration 5 against base 4 gives one chord-bound violation; unrelated invalid note does not erase it.
Invalid scalar prerequisites causally block only dependent positions; do not create secondary arithmetic failures.
boundary: A grace note has no ordinary duration and does not inherit a fabricated duration; cue duration follows the formal branch.
Repeated/nonnumeric measure labels and nonnumeric voice identifiers remain valid; partwise/timewise part occurrences resolve through actual score-part identity.
missing_fact: Missing initial divisions, incomplete Content hole, unresolved typed part, or missing chord anchor yields scoped unknown/blocked rather than inferred zero or success.
interaction: Reordered voices via backup/forward preserve musical positions independently of document order; same staff label in another part never aliases.
Cross-staff chord, voice transition, attributes/direction/backup between notes and grace/cue combinations each need source-grounded anchor disposition.

state.title: Effective-state history, closure and precedence
state.batch6: Publish divisions/key/time/staves/clef/transpose/instruments and typed scope/position provenance; resolve applicable history in musical order, including later XML changes at earlier score positions.
state.later: Only expressly split layout, playback, created-part and repeat/span consumers remain with batch 7. Core time/clef/transpose/instrument providers may not be blanket-deferred.

positive: Publish a key at position 1 after XML content at position 2, rewind and verify effective key at positions before/at/after 1 in both voice orders.
An explicit staff-2 key/time/transpose does not replace staff-1 state; unnumbered updates use each clause’s own all-staves semantics.
negative: Wrong-kind/wrong-part ID and invalid state scalar retain causal owners; state lookup cannot select arbitrary first/last conflicting evidence.
boundary: Conflicting simultaneous updates, all-staves plus specific-staff updates, and equal-time updates in different XML orders require reviewed precedence or explicit ambiguity.
Omitting a state field in a later attributes event must be tested against persistence/default semantics; no accidental reset to 1 or invented C major/4/4/treble.
missing_fact: Only closed applicable history proves absence. Interrupted traversal, unplaced changes or holes must prevent false absence without poisoning independent part/staff histories.
interaction: Queries/productions are immutable copied facts with source/model provenance; report copies survive Finish and independently concurrent assessments.
No provider can self-depend on the state it is establishing; bootstrap divisions/reordered-change ambiguity is explicit.

staff.title: Staff identity and staff-details state
staff.batch6: Retain exact staff count, numbered scopes, staff type/lines/tuning/capo/details history and explicit/default provenance; preserve zero and arbitrary-width source counts symbolically.
staff.later: Batch 7 staff rendering, system spacing and created-part/extraction consequences after explicit per-clause split.

positive: Absent initial staves yields the documented one-staff fact; explicit 2 and numbered staff-2 references have distinct scope.
Clef line beyond staff-lines remains permitted; hidden lines still count in pitch-position coordinates.
negative: Invalid staff-number scalar blocks only its selected update; do not silently move it to staff 1.
boundary: staves=0 is XSD-permitted; 2^64 source count remains exact and is not enumerated or truncated to host int.
A staff-details omission does not invent a five-line staff or tuning not supplied by a reviewed source.
missing_fact: Unknown count/assignment/history cannot establish existence or select a default staff; missing tuning does not mean pitch zero.
interaction: Keep staff, staff-line and string number directions distinct: staff top-down, staff line bottom-up, string high-to-low.
Capo shifts non-capo tuning by semitones; layout-only visibility must not change sounding cursor or erase staff identity.

key.title: Key history and numeral consumer
key.batch6: Publish traditional and nontraditional key structures, scope and history; consume explicit local numeral-key or a provably applicable encoded effective key.
key.later: Batch 7 rendering and broader harmonic interpretation/intent; batch 9 remaining external glyph closure.

positive: Valid local numeral-key satisfies its alternative even if no inherited key is available.
A key from an earlier measure applies to the matching part/staff; a late XML update at an earlier musical position is selected correctly.
negative: Complete supported absence of both local numeral-key and applicable encoded key fails the selected numeral obligation.
boundary: Nontraditional or empty schema-valid key content must retain exact structure, not be silently relabeled C major; examine whether it supplies the consumer’s required key evidence.
Key cancel compares/references prior signature state; no cancellation element is invented for C major/A minor transitions.
missing_fact: Invalid local numeral-key and missing timing/part/staff evidence remain causal incomplete; initial absence is not automatically a missing-key violation on every note.
interaction: Key at another staff/part does not satisfy numeral; invisible key remains semantic state; harmony kind=none applicability must be explicitly reviewed.

time.title: Time signature state
time.batch6: Preserve staff-scoped time structures, composite/additive beats, interchangeable forms and senza-misura, and documented symbol/separator/print defaults.
time.later: Batch 7 slash display, detailed beat interpretation and notation/rendering consumers that require extra reviewed grammar.

positive: Unnumbered 3+2/8 and composite 2/4+3/8 retain exact explicit structure in every relevant staff.
Senza-misura provides a known unmetered state and ignores time symbol.
negative: Invalid beats/beat-type schema facts block their own state; no type-duration or measure-fill failure is inferred.
boundary: Schema string beats/beat-type not supported by a reviewed numeric grammar remain structured known state with unavailable derived meter, not format-invalid.
Hidden time print-object=no preserves meter; repeated meter changes, interchangeable signatures and same-position conflicts are covered.
missing_fact: No encoded initial time remains unknown; no 4/4 fallback or guessed bar length.
interaction: Pickup, implicit and noncontrolling measures may not equal nominal meter; senza-misura never causes divide-by-zero or fabricated length.

clef.title: Clef state and display coordinates
clef.batch6: Publish clef sign/line/octave-change per exact staff; apply documented number=1, additional and mid-measure conditions only after review; keep display origin separate from sounding pitch.
clef.later: Batch 7 system-start printing and layout rendering; no universal treble fallback.

positive: Absent clef number addresses staff 1 only; explicit number=2 is isolated.
Clef line outside staff-lines remains valid; additional=yes records ignored line interpretation.
negative: Invalid sign/line scalar blocks its own state and dependent display calculation without inventing pitch invalidity.
boundary: Simultaneous additional clefs and principal clef, after-barline at start versus mid-measure, print-object=no and sign=none remain distinct.
missing_fact: Missing initial clef is unknown; display-percussion reference must not silently supply a real sounding treble clef.
interaction: Unpitched middle-line default, display-step/display-octave and hidden lines use explicit staff coordinates only; sounding pitch remains separate.

transpose.title: Transposition state and arithmetic
transpose.batch6: Publish explicit chromatic/diatonic/octave/doubling facts and staff scope; derive exact displacement where all necessary numeric inputs are known.
transpose.later: Batch 7 written-pitch intent and created-part consumers; joint written-transposition remains open until authoritative instrument/intent evidence exists.

positive: Chromatic 2 plus octave-change 1 produces semitone displacement 14; known diatonic 1 plus octave 1 gives spelling displacement 8.
Unnumbered transpose affects all staves, number=2 only staff 2; double above=no/absent adds lower octave while yes adds upper.
negative: Do not treat absent transpose as an error based on a Clarinet part-name; missing intent is unknown.
boundary: Fractional chromatic values remain exact; zero and absent diatonic stay distinct unless separately defaulted by a reviewed clause.
Created-part part-transpose and actual attributes/transpose retain separate owners.
missing_fact: Missing components or state do not become zero merely to complete arithmetic; invalid components carry causes.
interaction: Reuse concert-score constraint independently; no double count of shared transpose-additive and diatonic-plus-octave clause.

instrument.title: Instrument and sound state
instrument.batch6: Retain exact instruments count, typed instrument owners, explicit note assignments and time-scoped sound instrument/play changes, with local versus continuing scope and per-field provenance.
instrument.later: Batch 7 actual playback realization/repeat-pass semantics and inferred author intent; batch 8 linked parts/sounds resources, batch 9 dictionary closure.

positive: Two score instruments in one part remain separate typed identities; changes to I1 never alter I2 or another part.
Play in note affects only that note; play in sound continues at its effective position.
negative: Unique wrong-kind/wrong-part references fail the existing typed clause once; ambiguous/missing IDs block dependent state without a duplicate missing-ID predicate.
boundary: instruments=0 and 2^64 source values preserve formal domain; omitted instruments count=1 is not a guessed score-instrument ID.
Multiple note/instrument children remain allowed; absent note instrument is advisory in a multi-instrument part, not automatically invalid.
missing_fact: Instrument name, dictionary guesses and omitted assignments do not establish author intent or select the first instrument.
interaction: Sound local offset overrides direction offset; local note play does not leak to later notes; sound grouping order remains advice, not an adjacency constraint.

offset.title: Exact offsets, note association and timing origins
offset.batch6: Provide exact signed positions for direction/sound/listening and note-local attack/release/bend offsets; preserve precedence and visual-versus-performance channels without altering the score cursor.
offset.later: Batch 7 rendering coordinate calculation, repeat-aware performance, swing/grace realization and ambiguous note association after exact decision gates.

positive: At score cursor 2 with divisions 3, offset -1 gives position 5/3; cursor remains 2.
Local sound/listening offset overrides direction offset; attack and release are independent adjustments in divisions.
negative: Invalid offset/divisions blocks only dependent derived positions; no invented measure-boundary invalidity.
boundary: Zero and negative offsets, offset before measure start/after observed end, default sound=no, explicit sound=yes and default-x override are all separate cases.
missing_fact: No divisions or unknown parent origin yields unknown timing, not zero; unresolved voice selection does not pick the next lexical note.
interaction: Visual default-x can override visual offset without erasing sound offset; note attack/release do not shift following score notes.
Direction note association and figured-bass anchor must use musical order with documented voice/grace/chord rules.

repeat_span.title: Timeline-backed repeats, spans and later musical consumers
repeat_span.batch6: Supply exact positions, measure boundaries/occurrences, typed part/staff/voice scopes, note branches and normalized durations; preserve consumer-specific missing facts.
repeat_span.later: Batch 7 owns repeat/span correspondence, semantic event equivalence, layout/intent decisions and full consumer closure. Joint rows retain [6,7] until explicitly reconciled.

positive: Equivalent repeated ranges can have different divisions but identical exact normalized event timing.
Stop-before-start XML order can still describe ordered musical endpoints.
negative: Do not turn unpaired recommended endpoints or unmatched rendering positions into universal MusicXML failure.
boundary: Barline after zero-time attributes may still be at musical zero; duplicate/nonnumeric measure labels do not become identity keys.
missing_fact: Missing repeat graph, range correspondence, semantic equivalence or intent remains explicit even with a successful timeline provider.
interaction: Repeat content needs materialized encoded events, not an implied-playback repeat; display/transposition metadata equivalence needs separate review.
Measure rest and notated duration are not forced to equal a universal meter length.
